It is the strength of our  big population, that we have already  a huge purchasers of everything which we are producing in our Country. Whatever may be current situation of the world, India and country like us shall definitely survive from such conditions. So, friends, be calm and quiet and just watch the present situations. All the best dear friends. Radhe Krishna Krishna Hari.
